question: Under what temporal condition of practice are old age and death said to be destroyed?
premises: Practice is said to have been done for one year.
The condition is when it has been practiced.
Old age and death are the subjects.
Old age and death are destroyed.
inference: When this practice has been carried out for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The practice referred to is not named in this verse.
plain_english: When it has been practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
